name: Career Pivot Roadmap
description: Builds a dated, milestone-based career pivot roadmap covering skill gap analysis, credential requirements, portfolio plan, networking targets, and timeline. Produces a complete action plan document with specific dates and measurable milestones. Use when the user wants to change careers, transition to a new field, plan a career switch, or build a roadmap for entering a different industry. Do NOT use for job search strategy within the same field (use job-search-strategy), resume rewriting for a career change (use career-change-resume), or skill learning plans for professional development without a career change (use skill-gap-analysis).
